results.title: Parker Posey Joins 'Backrooms' Horror Film for October 2027 Release
results.description: Parker Posey has been cast in the upcoming horror adaptation of Backrooms, produced by Blumhouse and Universal Pictures, with a scheduled release date of October 8, 2027. While specific plot details remain under wraps, fans speculate on her role within the story based on the source material.

results.title: Kelly Clarkson Takes on Brooklyn Boutique Over £11,000 Singing Bird Purchase
results.description: Singer Kelly Clarkson has sparked a new controversy after a brief visit to Brooklyn's Art of Play shop. The pop icon, who previously sold a Jane Austen ring for over £150,000, alleged she was treated dismissively while attempting to buy a pricey mechanical bird. The incident drew millions of views on social media and has prompted a backlash against the boutique, leading to a fall in its online rating and a surge of critical reviews. Clarkson's outspoken social media post, her comparison to the film Pretty Woman, and the shop's security footage have all contributed to the unfolding drama.
